question: In the longest-common-subsequence table, the letters at (i, j) match. Which cell does the new value come from?
options: The larger of the cells above and to the left
explanation: Both matching letters can end the shared sequence, so the rest comes from both prefixes without them.

question: In 0/1 knapsack with a 1-D array, why does the loop over capacity go from high to low?
options: So each item is counted at most once
explanation: Going down, best[c − weight] still holds the value without this item. Going up would let the same item be added again.
